summary.text: Jeff Long (Jeffrie Long Jr.) is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 27B, where he has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a pastor.

paragraphs.text: Long earned a bachelor's degree in clinical psychology from Liberty University.
His career experience includes working as senior pastor of Communion Church in Huntingtown, Maryland, and as a legislative aide.
He won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary with 61.4% of the vote over Rachel Jones, and faces Republican Dan Thomas in the general election.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Environment and Transportation Committee.
